original.target_description: Primary original paper not obtained through permitted open-access routes. Locator names p. 7, Table 2 but gives no row, column, outcome, sample, or test identifier.

replication.target_description: Verified Haller, Flaherty and Balsvik (2023), DOI 10.18718/81781.29. Printed p. 24, Table A3 contains log annual wage regressions by high/low unionisation and skill intensity for Brazil, two Irish periods and Norway. PDF page 24 instead is printed p. 23, Table A2 with four specifications and those country/period panels. Neither interpretation selects one target test.

reported_success.location: Printed p. 2, Introduction (overall paper verdict; effect-specific verdict unresolved)
reported_success.quote: Our results confirm the evidence documented in Poole (2013) which suggests that when workers leave multinationals and are rehired at domestic establishments, the wages of workers who are already in these establishments and remain increase. We also document broadly similar tendencies in terms of heterogeneity. However, the comparisons across subsamples are not significant bar some few exceptions for Ireland.

notes: All assigned entries have identical locators, empty neutral descriptions and null study identifiers. No target row, coefficient, column, country or period can be assigned independently; input order was not used to assign tests. Original Table 2 is reproduced in replication Table A2 (printed p. 23), whereas supplied replication p. 24 points to Table A3 referring to original Table 3. Original statistics were not substituted from the replication paper. The reported_success field describes the authors’ overall narrative only and cannot resolve an effect-specific verdict.
